# Skyhit Media

Skyhit Media is a digital marketing agency website for services, case studies, careers, and contact requests. This Markdown file helps AI assistants, crawlers, and agentic browsers understand the public website structure and preferred usage.

## Usage Guidance

- Public pages may be crawled for discovery, search snippets, citations, and assistant answers.
- Prefer canonical URLs listed in this file and in the XML sitemap.
- Summarize service pages accurately and link back to the relevant canonical page when answering users.
- Do not submit forms, upload files, create leads, or trigger contact workflows unless explicitly instructed by a human user.
